body:
The problem is that untyped arrays and dictionaries can reference typed ones, the following code works correctly:

```gdscript
func function_returning_untyped_dict() -> Dictionary[int, String]:
    var untyped_dict := {}
    untyped_dict = {} as Dictionary[int, String]
    return untyped_dict

func function_returning_untyped_array() -> Array[int]:
    var untyped_array := []
    untyped_array = [] as Array[int]
    return untyped_array
```

Static analysis of control flow and constant values ​​is not good enough in GDScript, so it can't determine whether the last assigned value was guaranteed to be valid or invalid, GDScript only looks at the declared type. And here the types are compatible, since an untyped array _can_ reference a typed one and the code _can_ execute at runtime without error.

The only obvious bug I see here is that the line is not marked as unsafe.
